findingDetails.title: The reducer writes a ruled-out direction as a heading and drops the reason that closed it
findingDetails.scopeProof: key at reduce-state.cjs:407; print sites 2404 and 2405; blocked branch 2411 and 2413
findingDetails.claim: The exhausted-approaches projection keeps the direction text but replaces the reviewer's closing reason with a fixed sentence, so the strategy cannot carry the evidence that closed a direction.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: read buildExhaustedApproaches in full for a reason split; checked whether the strategy points at the iteration file; read extractListItems for a separator convention.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the strategy is meant to hold one-line directions and the iteration file the reason
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a documented contract naming the iteration file as the reason's home would make the loss intentional

findingDetails.title: A confirmed-clean surface is read as an exhausted direction when the iteration carries no Ruled Out heading
findingDetails.scopeProof: fallback chain at reduce-state.cjs:374 feeding ruledOut at 407 and the RULED OUT label at 2402
findingDetails.claim: When an iteration file has no Ruled Out section, the reducer treats its Confirmed-Clean items as ruled-out directions and projects them as exhausted approaches.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: searched for a second consumer of the fallback; counted archived iteration files carrying the heading (129); looked for a guard skipping the fallback.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the fallback exists for legacy files whose only closing section was Confirmed-Clean and whose items were directions
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a unit test showing a legacy file's Confirmed-Clean items are directions
